instruction: Open task-020_initial.scad and complete an instrument frame assembly in millimetres. Preserve the 130 x 90 x 6 mm base plate at x=[-65,65], y=[-45,45], z=[0,6]. Add a 130 x 90 x 4 mm top plate at x=[-65,65], y=[-45,45], z=[60,64]. Add four vertical posts of diameter 10 mm from z=6 to z=60, with centers at (-52,-32), (-52,32), (52,-32), and (52,32). Cut matching diameter-11 mm vertical clearance holes completely through the top plate over z=[60,64]. Cut two horizontal rounded cable slots completely through the base plate over z=[0,6]. The slots are oriented along X, centered at (-25,0) and (25,0), and each has an overall length of 28 mm, an overall width of 8 mm, and semicircular ends of radius 4 mm; their XY extents are respectively x=[-39,-11], y=[-4,4] and x=[11,39], y=[-4,4]. Cut four diameter-7 mm vertical mounting holes completely through the base plate over z=[0,6], with centers at (-45,0), (45,0), (0,-28), and (0,28). The slots and mounting holes must remain distinct openings. Do not add other geometry. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-020_output.3mf.
